headline: Mastercard (MA) Launches Scam Program And Expands Stablecoin Payment Infrastructure
summary: Mastercard launched a new Scam Merchant Monitoring Program that pushes acquiring banks to investigate suspected fraud within strict timelines. The company is expanding stablecoin settlement support, including through its acquisition of BVNK and a focus on deeper banking as a service offerings. These moves aim to tighten consumer protection and build out Mastercard’s infrastructure for stablecoin linked payments. Mastercard, traded as NYSE:MA, is leaning further into both fraud prevention...
